files.content:
PROJECT ZERO — DESKTOP README (DUMMY)

This desktop is the local recreation of the Zero cockpit: seven route windows over a token-driven wallpaper, with snap-to-grid icons.

- Icons snap to grid slots; positions persist per drop.
- Double-click an icon to open its route window or this viewer.
- Viewer windows are read-only and labeled dummy.

No file system is read by this viewer; every dummy file ships inside the app bundle.

files.name: architecture.pdf
files.content:
ARCHITECTURE — PDF MOCK (DUMMY)

zerod owns committed state on this Mac and serves HTTP + SSE over the owner-only Unix socket.
The desktop connects through that socket: the cockpit snapshot refreshes on stream events, and commands post through /v0.1/commands with explicit approvals.
Routes render from the snapshot. Codex and OpenCode run as manually connected stdio bridges; send stays blocked until the runtime path ships.
This PDF is a mock — the real document store is not wired yet.
